hook: Your drone can be burnt out of the sky by a laser.
title: India's Laser Burns Drones Out of the Sky
description:
In 2025 India's DRDO tested a 30-kilowatt laser weapon that brought down drones. The beam is invisible light and it heats the drone until it fails. It's a big step for India's defence tech.

#Shorts #Technology #India

scenes.narration: Your drone can be burnt out of the sky by a laser.
scenes.headline: LASER VS DRONE

scenes.narration: The beam stays on the drone.
scenes.headline: LOCKED ON

scenes.narration: The drone heats up and fails.
scenes.headline: BURNT OUT

scenes.narration: Then it drops out of the sky.
scenes.headline: DRONE DOWN

scenes.narration: No missile needed, just a beam of light.
scenes.headline: JUST LIGHT

scenes.narration: Your drone met a laser, and lost.
scenes.headline: LASER WINS
